text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 99 vials of adenosine 3 mg/mL 2 mL solution (Gland Pharma Limited, NDC 68083015610) with 5.9 days on hand at 16.9 vials per day. Corvale General holds 235 vials of the same presentation with 15.4 days on hand at 15.2 vials per day. Corvale Lakeside holds 96 vials of 4 mL presentation with 21.3 days on hand. FDA's drug shortage list does not include adenosine as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include adenosine as of 2026-10-21. Gland Pharma Limited's registered plant (FEI 3002647489) was last inspected 2024-07-25 and classified VAI.

Our position: No national shortage exists per FDA records. The imbalance is local to Corvale East's 2 mL vial stock. Other presentations and sites have adequate supply. Purchasing from alternative manufacturers is possible but not urgent.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 21 vials of adenosine 3 mg/mL 2 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
2. Monitor daily use at both sites and adjust par levels — needs pharmacy director approval.
3. Evaluate alternative manufacturers (Eugia US LLC, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Gland Pharma Limited, Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc.) for future orders — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: Emergency purchases or allocation changes beyond the transfer above. No clinical protocol changes are recommended; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
